identificationModule.briefTitle: STRETCH OF RESPIRATORY MUSCLES IN PATIENTS WITH CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE
identificationModule.officialTitle: EFFECTS OF RESPIRATORY MUSCLE STRETCH ON THORACOABDOMINAL MECHANIC, FUNCTIONAL CAPACITY, PSYCHOLOGICAL AND SOCIAL ASPECTS IN PATIENTS WITH CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE

descriptionModule.briefSummary: THE AIM OF THIS STUDY IS TO TEST IF THE STRETCHING OF THE RESPIRATORY ACCESSORY MUSCLE PROVIDE SOME BENEFIT ON THORACOABDOMINAL MECHANICS, FUNCTIONAL CAPACITY, PSYCHOLOGICAL AND SOCIAL ASPECTS IN PATIENTS WITH CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: PATIENTS WITH CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE WILL BE SUBMITTED TO PASSIVE STRETCHING OF RESPIRATORY MUSCLES AND EXERCISE IN TREADMILL DURING 12 WEEKS, TWICE A WEEK. ONE WEEK AFTER THE TRAINING PERIOD, THE FUNCTIONAL CAPACITY, THE THORACOABDOMINAL MECHANICS AND LEVELS OF ANXIETY AND DEPRESSION WILL BE ASSESSED.

armGroups.label: Treatment Group
armGroups.description: The group submitted to stretching exercises in the respiratory muscles and treadmill exercises

armGroups.label: Control Group
armGroups.description: The control group received stretching exercises in the fist and ankle muscles and treadmill exercises

interventions.name: Stretching Exercises
interventions.description: The group submitted to stretching exercises in the respiratory muscles and treadmill exercises

primaryOutcomes.description: Distance obtained (in meters) during six minutes walking test
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: One week after the end of training

secondaryOutcomes.description: The kinematic will be analyzed by optoelectronic plethysmograph during 30 seconds at rest, followed by 30 seconds after 3 minutes cycling without load, followed by 30 seconds after 30 minutes pedaling with load (25% of the calculated maximum watt).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: One week after the end of training

otherOutcomes.timeFrame: One week after the end of training

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Diagnosis
* Clinical stability
* Absence of previous thoracic surgery
* Absence of other limitations

Exclusion Criteria:

* Copd exacerbation
* Absence greater than three days
